learning_objective_summary: Measurement mengubah interaksi menjadi data yang dapat dipercaya. Mulai dari business question, framework, event taxonomy, data layer/parameter, source of truth, consent, dan QA—baru kemudian dashboard. learning_objective_summary: CRO dan experimentation mengubah diagnosis funnel menjadi hipotesis yang diuji. CRO bukan hanya mengubah warna tombol; ia menggabungkan research, analytics, usability, page performance, offer clarity, trust, friction, dan operational constraints. Hipotesis menyebut observation, insight, change, expected mechanism, audience, dan metric. A/B testing memerlukan randomization, unit tepat, primary metric, guardrails, sample/duration, stopping rule, serta kontrol kontaminasi. Conversion rate naik belum tentu profit naik bila kualitas order turun.
